name: record_context_outcome
description: Record used/ignored/misleading context as a shadow RetrievalSignal(context_outcome); never changes confirmed truth. Opt-in ranking may use the signal as a small explainable hint.

surface.description: Surface that returned the context, e.g. wake, search_memory, file_context.

source_ids.description: Optional returned source ids being rated. Omit when an opaque retrieval_id is available.

reason.description: Optional short note. Avoid raw task content.

retrieval_id.description: Opaque id returned by wake/search for exact surface-to-outcome correlation. Contains no query or memory content.
